config.grain_rationale: One row per ACNC-registered charity; the record describes the registered legal entity and its registered business/contact address. ABN is not guaranteed unique (duplicates/blanks occur), so record identity is content-derived.

record_id.rationale: ABN is blank in ~0.6% of rows and repeats for some entities, so it is not a reliable unique key; hash the full record content instead.

fields.rationale: Column explicitly named Charity_Legal_Name on the ACNC register = registered legal name.
Other names the charity is known by (trading/display names), explicitly separate from the legal name column.
ABN column; 100% checksum-valid in discovery profile (11-digit shape).

Legal-form stated in-record by the name itself, not guessed: leading 'The Trustee for ...' (prefix form, how trustee company names are rendered) -> trust; trailing Incorporated/Inc/Association Incorporated/Aboriginal Corporation -> incorporated_association; Pty Ltd/Proprietary Limited/Ltd/Limited -> company; trailing Trust -> trust. map_enum has no passthrough, so names with no recognised legal form emit nothing and stay unknown rather than being guessed. Does not treat 'Association'/'Foundation' alone as legal forms.

Charity_Website mostly holds bare domains or one http(s) URL. Some cells hold prose/multiple URLs crammed together (e.g. 'HTTPS://WWW.ALLMYLINKS.COM/... AND WWW.CHARITYCONSULTANTS.ORG.AU (WWWW.NFPCCC.AU)'); regex_extract takes the first well-formed domain/URL and website validates it, so that cell yields one clean website instead of a WEBSITE_INVALID error.
ACNC registration date; all values match DD/MM/YYYY shape (day-first confirmed by values with day>12).

STREET LINES ONLY. This is the registered 'Business' contact address (Address_Type uniformly 'Business') - a postal/contact address that may be a PO box or just a premises name ('Egan Park', 'Community Centre') with no street number, so treat it as a contact sub-address, not a deliverable/full address. locality/state/postcode are emitted separately and should be joined downstream to build a deliverable address.
Town/city (suburb) field; values preserved as-is including mixed case and source typos.
Australian state abbreviations; state transform normalises (including trailing space, e.g. 'SA ') and maps unknown to OTHER.
4-digit Australian postcodes. A few source defects (6-digit '139658', truncated '80571', suburb name 'Cloverdale') fail validation by design rather than emitting junk.

Country field (88.7% present). trim/collapse_whitespace + upper, then regex_extract admits only letters/space/period so state+postcode junk ('WA 6105') and blanks emit nothing. Only values with independent support are mapped: Australian spellings including misspellings ('Australia', 'Australia.', 'Australian', 'AUSRALIA', 'AU', 'AUS') -> AU, and 'Singapore' -> SG. map_enum passthrough=false and default=null, so everything else - notably 'Austria'/'AUSTRIA.' typed into a Victorian charity's row, and state names typed into Country ('Victoria', 'Tasmania') - emits NOTHING rather than a confidently wrong ISO code. Non-AU values must not be trusted from this column: the register is AU-focused and Operating_Countries (e.g. 'AUS') contradicts such entries.

unmapped.reason: Single constant value 'Business' on all rows; address contact type, no ontology target.

When the organisation was founded, not when ACNC registration became true; explicitly NOT a substitute for date_registered (held-out rows show establishment long before registration, e.g. established 31/12/1889 vs registered 03/12/2012).

ACNC revenue-size band (Small/Medium/Large), not an ANZSIC industry code; no ontology target. NB the dataset has no industry column at all, so entity.industry_code is structurally unobtainable for this source.
Governance headcount; no ontology target and not a valid proxy for entity.status (0/null means unreported, not deregistered).
Reporting period fit (e.g. 30-Jun); not a valid_from/valid_to date.
State operation flag; address.state comes from the registered address, not operation footprint.

config.notes: Critic fixes applied. (1) address.country: foreign values are NO LONGER emitted. The earlier AT mapping turned an obvious source typo ('Austria' on a Victorian charity whose Operating_Countries is AUS) into a confidently typed wrong code; now only Australian spellings (incl. misspellings AUSTRALIAN/AUSRALIA) map to AU and 'Singapore' to SG, with passthrough=false and default=null so 'Austria', 'VICTORIA' and 'TASMANIA' typed into Country emit nothing. (2) entity.entity_type tightened: added the leading 'The Trustee for ...' prefix rule so trustee names classify as trust, and map_enum has no passthrough so unrecognised names stay unknown instead of being guessed; 'Association'/'Foundation' alone are deliberately not treated as legal forms. (3) address.full documented in-field as street lines of a Business/contact address, NOT a deliverable full address; locality/state/postcode are separate fields to be joined downstream. entity.status and entity.industry_code remain unmapped: this extract has no status and no industry column, so both are structurally unobtainable and should be treated as unknown. Postcode defects ('139658', '80571', 'Cloverdale') are rejected by design.
